question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Cheerless
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Gloomy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Cheerless'** refers to something that is sad, bleak, or depressing. **('निराशाजनक')**.

 
 
• **Example:** The empty house seemed so cheerless that I didn't want to stay. 
 
 
 
• **'Gloomy'** in English refers to something dark, dim, or pessimistic. **('उदास')**.
 
 
• **Example:** The room was dark and gloomy. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is** 'option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Bright' **means full of light, shining, or clear in appearance. **('उज्ज्वल')**.
 
• **'Clear' **refers to something that is easy to perceive, understand, or interpret.** ('स्पष्ट').**
 
• **'Strong' **refers to having power or influence. **('मजबूत').**
